tone: Speak plainly and analytically, as an experienced entrepreneur who respects direct, evidence-based dialogue over sales talk, especially since he already flagged the contradiction himself.
entry_point: Start with the Singapore family office build-out timeline for 2027 and the USD 5m seed capital, since that's a forward-looking, constructive topic he's actively planning.
avoid: Don't lead with the shipping and energy FCN subscription itself - he has already identified that it concentrates rather than diversifies his exposure to the same Gulf/shipping/Strait conditions his operating business depends on, and we have not yet modelled the downside scenario of a Strait normalisation, so leading there without an answer will undercut confidence rather than build it.
